scoring_justification: Checker recomputes bond distances from submitted XYZ coordinates. For DFT, structural check of bidentate chemisorption; for QM/MM, recomputed H-bond distance compared to paper-reported 2.07 Å within tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Target hydrogen bond distance for QM/MM check
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 1c explicitly states O···HO distance = 2.07 Å.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly taken from paper's reported value.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the paper's own numerical result for the QM/MM hydrogen bond geometry.

outputs.description: Optimized adsorption geometry on Al(022) showing bidentate Al–O bonds; checker compares Al–O distances to a hidden reference value within tolerance.
QM/MM optimized geometry on Al(OH)3(001) with the shortest O···HO hydrogen bond distance; checker compares the distance to a hidden reference value within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute distances from the provided coordinates to verify the reported values. The target policy 'exact_match' is used because the bond distances are physical quantities whose correct values are determined by the computational procedure; a tolerance window is applied to absorb differences between open-source toolchains and the original calculation.

steps.description: Verify exactly two Al-O bonds from OPA PO3 oxygens to surface Al atoms, with distances in chemisorption range 1.8-2.2 Å.
Recomputed shortest O···HO distance from coordinates must match paper-reported 2.07 Å within 0.1 Å.
